text: Since you have no systemic symptoms like rash or joint pain, and your cough is productive with thick yellow sputum, this strongly suggests a post-infectious bronchitis or potentially early-stage chronic bronchitis. text: Based on your history of smoking, construction dust exposure, and a productive cough lasting over three weeks without systemic symptoms like fever or weight loss, this clinical picture is highly suggestive of Chronic Bronchitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis
